title: Document the acceptance-evaluation endpoints' retryable 503 refusals in docs/architecture.md
outcome: The acceptance-evaluation endpoint rows in docs/architecture.md list the retryable 503 refusals next to the final ones, so callers do not mistake a retryable refusal for a final one: "authority transition in flight" (wait the named seconds and repeat the identical request) and the durability-pending acknowledgement.
acceptance: docs/architecture.md's acceptance-evaluation request and submit rows name the retryable 503 "authority transition in flight" (with its retry-after wording) and the durability-pending 503, each with what the caller should do, distinguished from the final 409 refusals.
